insights.one_liner: Dutch sustainable food ingredients company with over a century of history, an IND recognised sponsor with an entry-level IT role in Gorinchem.

culture.text: Makes lactic acid, food preservation solutions, functional blends and algae ingredients, with a focus on food, health and the planet.
Founded in 1919 and headquartered in Diemen.
Its open entry-level IT and security job is in Gorinchem.

open.text: TotalEnergies Corbion B.V. is an IND recognised sponsor.
Its open Gorinchem role needs no Dutch.

growth.text: Launched its second cultured preservation solution for food makers.

worth_knowing.text: CEO Olivier Rigaud will step down on 12 May 2027 and the search for a successor has started.
